answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37398 Country: India Title: I have a question which a friend of mine told me. He wants to know that if a person fulfills his sexual desire after eating a morsel of haram food and her wife conceives on the same night, the son/daughter born is not legitimate Question: I have a question which a friend of mine told me. He wants to know that if a person fulfills his sexual desire after eating a morsel of haram food and her wife conceives on the same night, the son/daughter born is not legitimate. Kindly give a detailed answer. Answer ID: 37398 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 513/513/M=1433) He shall be sinful for eating morsel of haram food; hence it is necessary to avoid it. But the child that is born from his wife shall not be unlawful and illegitimate, rather his linage shall establish from the husband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
